comment: Canonical universal-link path-prefix manifest for https://crumbify.co.uk share/deep links (pixel-fix W3R1-share-f53b-01, 2026-08-06 orchestrator adjudication). This file is DUPLICATED VERBATIM (same host + prefixes array) in the sibling app repo at docs/deeplinks/universal-link-prefixes.json - that is this file's TWIN. Each repo's own static-analysis guard test asserts its OWN platform config matches ITS OWN copy of this manifest: the website repo's src/__tests__/well-known/universal-link-prefix-manifest-parity.test.ts checks public/.well-known/apple-app-site-association against this copy; the app repo's __tests__/regression/universal-link-prefix-manifest-parity.test.ts checks app.json's Android intentFilters against its copy. The two copies are NOT diffed automatically across repos (they run in separate CI checkouts) - keeping them in sync is a manual-but-guarded discipline: whenever a share surface is added or removed, edit BOTH copies of this file in the SAME PR-pair and re-run BOTH repos' parity guards before merging either. A stale/missing entry in one repo's copy is caught immediately by that repo's own guard; a forgotten update to the OTHER repo's copy is caught by comparing this comment's twin pointer against the sibling file during review.
twin: crumbdotco/app repo, docs/deeplinks/universal-link-prefixes.json (sibling repo checkout - not resolvable by path from this repo's CI, cross-referenced by filename/comment for manual review only)

prefixes.note: referral links, https://crumbify.co.uk/ref?u=<username> (utils/referral-link.ts). Bare entry like /invite (no trailing path segment - the path is exactly /ref, everything after is the ?u= query string, so a trailing-slash prefix would never match). v0.9.4 T16 A6-1: this path existed in the app's referral-link builder and app/_layout.tsx's deep-link handler since Phase 13/14 but was never added to this manifest or app.json's Android intentFilters, so neither iOS Universal Links nor Android App Links ever claimed it - a tap on a referral link fell through to the browser instead of opening the app.
